buckets.A: TOP4-BEATERS TRAIN (dynamic top 4) + 09-30 wins by current top-12 teams

qualifying: not leak / MMPQ-VAL / sealed / practice-VAL / decode holdout seed / TOP4-BEATERS VAL
top10_rank: mean(game_score, opp_game_score) at game time; else mean(rating, opp_rating) leaderboard; per day
sampling: pick a bucket by share (A..E; control renormalises A..E; S only in test branches), then a seat uniformly within it
publish_refusal: any bucket that is non-empty upstream but loses > 10% of its seats to missing cache

S.what: self-play bucket (gpu-scout builds it); used only in test branches until it passes a gate
S.lists: /mnt/ai/scratch/farmNEAT/selfplay-s/S-<L>.tsv (per lineage B/O/N; owner gpu-scout; receipt selfplay-s/S0-RECEIPT.json)
S.share_rule_terms: n_S = cached seats in selfplay-s/S-<L>.tsv; n_A = cached seats in the same bucket generation A.tsv; no S seat drawn more often than an A seat
S.min_seats_rule: no S test branch before n_S >= 300 per lineage
S.enforced_by: selfplay-s/build_test_roster.py (refuses below min_seats; receipts the computed share); source of rule: coordinator 04:3x via gpu-scout

beat_us_rule: winner seats with opp_is_us (they beat our hosted bots) are kept only for game days 09-29/09-30; earlier days dropped from every bucket (owner 04:1x)

small_bucket_cap.rule: r_A = share_A/n_A (recipe shares normalised over A..E, S excluded; n = cached seats); for k != A: share_k <= 4*r_A*n_k; all excess share goes to A; one pass from pre-cap r_A; recomputed every build
small_bucket_cap.output: buckets/<gen>/EFFECTIVE-SHARES.json; trainers sample from it, not from the raw shares

beat_us_bucket_rule: coordinator 07:2x (owner "make sure we're training on our losses too"): bucket L = the WINNER seat of every game one of our submissions lost on beat_us_days (09-29/30), any source; assigned before A/TOP4/BC so no seat counts twice; our losing seat is never an action target. L share is dynamic: per-seat draw rate = 4 x A per-seat rate after rescaling A/BC/D/E proportionally (x = k/(1+k), k = 4*base_A*n_L/n_A)

a_top.rule: owner 09-30 08:3x "lets prioritize top 10": A = TOP4 TRAIN + wins of the live top-10 teams (build-time leaderboard, us excluded) on 09-29/30; L assigned after A overrides for winners over us; TOP10-BEATERS (owner 11:3x): winner seats of games whose LOSER is a current top-10 team (a_top days) also go to A

m_bucket.rule: owner 14:2x: winner seats of 09-30 games with a seat ranked 15-40 (us excluded); L keeps priority; A first

window_rule: owner 14:1x: only 09-29/30 games from now on (D/E removed); t1 keeps all MMPQ dates

x_bucket.rule: owner 14:4x: winner seat of 09-30 games whose LOSER was the newest submission (max submission id in the catalog) of a team ranked 1-40 (us excluded); X over A/M/BC; L keeps us

own_rule: D-1613own 16:1x: no own or self-play winning seats in any bucket; S reserve 0; L (others beating us) kept
